description: The line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = small," illustrates the WER (Word Error Rate) performance of four different models—small AdaLoRA_int4, small AdaLoRA_int8, small int4, and small int8—across six epochs of fine-tuning. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," is also a linear scale, ranging from 25.0 to 42.5, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 2.5. Each model is represented by a distinct line: small AdaLoRA_int4 (solid brown), small AdaLoRA_int8 (dashed brown), small int4 (dotted brown), and small int8 (dash-dot brown). The small AdaLoRA_int4 model starts with a WER of approximately 35.5 at epoch 0, peaks at 42.5 at epoch 2, and then decreases to about 31.8 at epoch 6. The small AdaLoRA_int8 model begins at 30.0, rises to 40.0 at epoch 1, peaks at 42.5 at epoch 2, and then declines to 30.0 at epoch 6. The small int4 model starts at 30.0, decreases to 28.0 at epoch 3, then rises to 27.5 at epoch 4, and continues to decline to 25.0 at epoch 6. The small int8 model starts at 30.0, decreases to 28.0 at epoch 1, then rises to 33.5 at epoch 2, and continues to decline to 25.0 at epoch 6.
